map.按花纹深度判换胎: Deciding on replacement from tread depth
map.法定极限胎纹≥1.6mm，建议湿地多的车到 3mm 就换。新胎 8mm，若每 1: The legal limit is ≥1.6mm of tread, and cars often driven in the wet should be replaced at 3mm. A new tire starts at 8mm, so wearing 1mm per 10000 km leaves about 64000 km; if the front tires show feathered wear, camber or toe is usually out, so get a four-wheel alignment before fitting new tires.
map.为什么看指示块不看年限？: Why watch the wear bars rather than the age?
map.磨损到 1.6mm 湿地排水能力骤降、易水滑，比年限更直接关系到安全。老化裂纹另: At 1.6mm wet drainage collapses and aquaplaning risk rises sharply, which relates to safety far more directly than age. Aging cracks are a separate issue that must be combined with tire age.
map.偏磨换了还磨怎么办？: Uneven wear came back after new tires - what now?
map.偏磨根因在定位或悬挂，不修因只换胎会很快再磨。先四轮定位、查摆臂球头，再装新胎。: The root cause lies in alignment or suspension; fitting tires without fixing it only wears them out again. Do a four-wheel alignment and check control arms and ball joints first, then fit new tires.
